story.headline: Calvary Ellicott
paragraphs: Our congregation is prayerfully preparing for a new season as a locally led church serving Ellicott and the surrounding plains. While our name and organizational relationship may be changing, our foundation is not: Jesus Christ, the authority of Scripture, and the call to make disciples.
We’re grateful for our history with Rocky Mountain Calvary and hopeful about what God is building here. We’ll share formal updates with clarity as decisions are finalized.

headline: Historic faith.
Everyday hope.
hero.lead: We hold to the historic Christian faith and seek to live it with conviction, humility, and love.

headline: What we
hold to.
intro.text: These convictions shape how we worship, teach, and care for one another.

items.title: The Bible
items.text: We believe the Scriptures are inspired by God, trustworthy, and our final authority for faith and life.

items.title: God
items.text: We believe in one God—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit—eternal, holy, loving, and sovereign over all.

items.title: Jesus Christ
items.text: We believe Jesus is fully God and fully man, lived without sin, died for our sins, rose bodily, and will return.

items.title: Salvation
items.text: We believe salvation is God’s gift of grace, received through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ—not earned by our works.

items.title: The Church
items.text: We believe the Church is the family of all who follow Jesus, called to worship, grow, serve, and make disciples together.
